# Boundary axioms of the accepted extraction.
#
# `audit-extraction.py` accepts exactly the names listed here and rejects every other `axiom` in
# the generated `ApeironWord.lean`. `sorry` and `admit` are rejected unconditionally. An entry
# whose declaration is absent from the generated file is also a failure, so this list cannot
# accumulate dead permissions.
#
# Format: <generated Lean axiom name><TAB><why it is admitted>
#
# Every entry is an operation Charon did not translate or the pinned Aeneas Lean model does not
# define, so Aeneas emits it as an `axiom`. Each class below is a named trust boundary; every claim
# about an extracted body that calls one is relative to it. Classes marked `shrink-only` are
# obligations to model or remove, not permanent permissions: the list may lose entries and never
# gains one without an owner-reviewed class.
